HDFC is a fraud bank. I agreed for a small loan of 1 lakh upon repeated queries from their agents and the experience has been horrible. They charged 7% processing charge, and other charges on 1 lakh loan, and disbursed 91,800/- rupees only. On top of that, they added undisclosed insurance policies , forcing my principal amount to 1,08,000/- instead of 1 lakh. Due to this, my monthly emi shot up by 1000/- rupees, making total cost if loan from the expected 10k to 23k!

I’m currently forced to hassle my way out of this situation even when o cancelled the loan the very next day of disbursement, which is within the cooling of period of 3 days. 

The bank is not helping me with my right to cancel the loan and imposing foreclosure for the delay caused due to their own internal administrative delays/ timelines. 

This just shows how this bank is allowing its employees to harass customers just to manage their own targets. They don’t care if a customer goes in loss, they just want their targets to complete.

Right time to invest in hdfc

In the last five years, HDFC Bank paid Rs. 93.50 as a dividend, so it is not right to say it didn't give any returns. However, even though it hit its highest price of around 1,020 last December (2025), the capital growth is almost zero

In the stock market, higher expectations often lead to lower returns, while lower expectations can create the potential for higher returns.

Since investors had very high expectations from HDFC, lower returns were almost inevitable. Now, given its recent performance, expectations are likely to fall, and some investors may start exiting the stock.

And that could be the very point when the stock surprises everyone and starts to boom.
